firm_os_b2b.rationale: High density data needs authority, clarity, and function-first UI. Avoids generic SaaS blue/purple. Focuses on speed and 'command-line' efficiency.

aftercare_b2c.rationale: Injured clients need warmth, calm, and trust. Uses soft sages, warm beige, and terracotta to avoid a clinical or intimidating legal feel.

data_and_numbers.usage: Use for numerical data, tables, case IDs, and timestamps to ensure vertical alignment.

firm_os_rules.grid: Control Room Grid (grid-cols-12, gap-4 tight spacing).
firm_os_rules.cards: Flat surfaces, no shadows. 1px solid border (border-border), rounded-sm (2px).
firm_os_rules.density: High density. Use weight instead of size for hierarchy.

aftercare_rules.grid: Mobile-first, single column or max 2 columns.
aftercare_rules.cards: Soft neumorphism, generous padding (p-6 to p-8), rounded-2xl to rounded-3xl.

command_palette.typography: Geist Mono for commands, IBM Plex Sans for descriptions.
command_palette.interaction: Instant search, keyboard-navigable, highlight matching text in primary_accent.

cocounsel_ai_sidebar.style: Distinct background tint (e.g., #F0EFEA in light mode) to separate AI context from manual data.
cocounsel_ai_sidebar.components: Chat bubbles (rounded-lg), action chips for quick prompts, markdown-rendered responses.

matters_kanban.layout: Horizontal scroll container, fixed column widths.
matters_kanban.cards: Dense data cards. Top-left: Matter ID (Geist Mono). Top-right: Status pip. Bottom: Next Best Action (NBA) CTA.
matters_kanban.interaction: Drag-and-drop enabled, subtle lift (-translate-y-0.5) and border darken on hover.

buttons.firm_primary: bg-primary_accent text-white rounded-sm font-semibold tracking-wide px-4 py-2 hover:bg-primary_accent_hover transition-colors
buttons.firm_secondary: bg-transparent border border-border text-text_primary rounded-sm px-4 py-2 hover:bg-surface/50
buttons.aftercare_primary: bg-primary_accent text-white rounded-full font-medium px-6 py-3 shadow-sm hover:opacity-90

component_patterns.testing: CRITICAL: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='login-submit-button').

structure: Left Sidebar (Global Nav, dark theme applied to sidebar itself)
Top Bar (Breadcrumbs + Global Search/Command Palette trigger + User Profile)
Top Row: Key Metrics (North Star) spanning col-span-3 each
Secondary Nav (Matter-specific tabs: Docs, MedConnect, Notes, Chat)
Hero Greeting ('Good morning, Sarah' + Warm graphic)
Bottom Nav Bar (Home, Journey, Messages, Profile)

instructions_to_main_agent: INSTALLATION: Run `yarn add @phosphor-icons/react` for the high-end duotone B2B icons, and `yarn add lucide-react` as a fallback.
COMPONENT LIBRARY: Heavily customize Shadcn components. Strip the 'Vercel-look'. Overwrite rounded-md to rounded-sm for B2B surfaces, and rounded-2xl for AfterCare.
FONTS: Configure Tailwind to load Cabinet Grotesk, IBM Plex Sans, Geist Mono, and Outfit via next/font or Google Fonts.
B2B DASHBOARD: Use the Grid Borders 'Technical Look' for data-heavy sections (border-collapse, border-r border-b). Ensure tabular numerals are active for data tables.
CONSUMER APP (AfterCare): Use Glassmorphism (Crystal/Apple Variant) for headers and sticky elements. Background must be light/warm (#FDFBF7).
ACCESSIBILITY: Adhere to strict WCAG AA contrast, especially for the high-density B2B dashboards.
TESTING: Apply `data-testid` to all interactive components.
RESPONSIVE: The main Firm OS dashboard is desktop-optimized (power users). AfterCare is explicitly mobile-first PWA.
